stem: How do the events that happen with Lina and Joelle’s friends help develop Lina’s character?

options.label: A
options.text: Lina’s performance for her friends indicates her desire to attract more attention.

options.label: B
options.text: Lina’s lack of response to the question about her songwriting reveals that she doubts her skills.

options.label: C
options.text: Lina’s objections to the recordings of her songs show that she prefers to play them live.

options.label: D
options.text: Lina’s departure from the group emphasizes her reluctance to express strong feelings.
